# trademark status

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](gmeow-trademarkStatus.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/trademarkStatus>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The status of a trademark — one of the [`gmeow:TrademarkStatus`](../classes/gmeow-TrademarkStatus.md) values (unregistered ™ / registered ® / pending / expired / cancelled). Functional.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) -> [`gmeow:TrademarkStatus`](../classes/gmeow-TrademarkStatus.md); functional

Use [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](gmeow-trademarkStatus.md) from [`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) to [`gmeow:TrademarkStatus`](../classes/gmeow-TrademarkStatus.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md), [`gmeow:TrademarkStatus`](../classes/gmeow-TrademarkStatus.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the registration status of a trademark — unregistered ™, registered ®, pending, expired, or cancelled — by referencing a [`gmeow:TrademarkStatus`](../classes/gmeow-TrademarkStatus.md) value.

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for copyright or licence standing ([`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](gmeow-copyrightStatus.md) / [`gmeow:licenseFamily`](gmeow-licenseFamily.md)) and avoid deleting a lapsed mark — set [`gmeow:trademarkStatusExpired`](../individuals/gmeow-trademarkStatusExpired.md) and record [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md) ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](gmeow-trademarkStatus.md) once per [`Trademark`](../classes/gmeow-Trademark.md) (functional) to a [`gmeow:TrademarkStatus`](../classes/gmeow-TrademarkStatus.md) value; on lapse, change the value and add [`gmeow:validUntil`](gmeow-validUntil.md) rather than removing the record.

### Examples

- ex:blackcatTM [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](gmeow-trademarkStatus.md) [`gmeow:trademarkStatusRegistered`](../individuals/gmeow-trademarkStatusRegistered.md).
